MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word is pronounced nín hǎo? (1 mark)
   A. 谢谢
   B. 您好
   C. 你
   D. 呢

2. In the syllable hǎo, which part is the final? (1 mark)
   A. o only
   B. h
   C. hǎ
   D. ao

3. What does 和 (hé) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Father
   B. That
   C. Mother
   D. And

4. Which sentence is a correct answer to 这是谁? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我妈妈。
   B. 电视在哪儿?
   C. 这是什么?
   D. 我在家。

5. What is the Chinese question for "Where is the television?" (1 mark)
   A. 这是电视吗?
   B. 电视在哪儿?
   C. 电视是谁?
   D. 电视有什么?

6. Why is it a good habit to keep household items in their proper places? (1 mark)
   A. It makes the house noisy
   B. It makes things harder to find
   C. It keeps the home tidy and safe
   D. It wastes time

7. What does 星期 xīngqī mean? (1 mark)
   A. Month
   B. Day
   C. Week
   D. Year

8. Which sentence means "On Friday, go to the mosque."? (1 mark)
   A. 我星期三去学校。
   B. 星期五,去清真寺。
   C. 明天是星期四。
   D. 星期天,去教堂。

9. What does 明天 (míngtiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To rest
   B. Tomorrow
   C. Mosque
   D. To go

10. What does 玩 (wán) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To wish
   B. Plate
   C. Candle
   D. To play

11. What does 祝 (zhù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Knife
   B. To wish
   C. They
   D. Cup

12. Which is a good step for reading a sentence at a good pace? (1 mark)
   A. Read without looking
   B. Read as fast as you can at once
   C. Read slowly first, then join the words and speed up
   D. Read only the first word

13. What does 葡萄 (pútao) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cooked rice
   B. Grapes
   C. Beef
   D. Snacks

14. Which sentence means "I use my eyes to see."? (1 mark)
   A. 我用耳朵听。
   B. 我有两只眼睛。
   C. 我用眼睛看。
   D. 我用嘴巴说。

15. Which Chinese word means "to touch"? (1 mark)
   A. 摸 mō
   B. 肩膀 jiānbǎng
   C. 哭 kū
   D. 用 yòng

16. Why is it good to retell what you heard in your own words? (1 mark)
   A. It shows you understood the key points
   B. It makes you forget
   C. It is only for teachers
   D. It is a way to play

17. Which word means "very" in 雨很大? (1 mark)
   A. 大
   B. 很
   C. 的
   D. 雨

18. Which word means "beside"? (1 mark)
   A. 下面
   B. 上面
   C. 旁边
   D. 里

19. Which sentence means "The garden is on the right of the house."? (1 mark)
   A. 床在卧室。
   B. 花园在房子右边。
   C. 沙发在哪儿?
   D. 电视在哪儿?

20. Which sentence means "Thank you!"? (1 mark)
   A. 老师好!
   B. 谢谢!
   C. 我叫小明。
   D. 你呢?

21. What does 对 duì mean in a true-or-false exercise? (1 mark)
   A. Father
   B. Wrong
   C. Right
   D. Family

22. What does 厕所 (cèsuǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Garden
   B. Left side
   C. Is at, is in
   D. Toilet

23. What does 星期六 (xīngqīliù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Eight
   B. Saturday
   C. Church
   D. Three

24. Which sentence means "My friend gives me a gift."? (1 mark)
   A. 我们切蛋糕。
   B. 我的生日是三月五号。
   C. 祝你生日快乐!
   D. 朋友送我礼物。

25. What does 送 (sòng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To give (a gift)
   B. Happy
   C. Which number, how many
   D. Candle

26. What does 我们 (wǒmen) mean? (1 mark)
   A. We
   B. Candle
   C. They
   D. Everybody

27. Which word is pronounced xiāngjiāo? (1 mark)
   A. 香蕉
   B. 牛奶
   C. 蔬菜
   D. 米饭

28. What is scanning? (1 mark)
   A. Looking for one particular word or fact
   B. Reading slowly word by word
   C. Drawing a picture
   D. Singing a song

29. Read the pinyin: zhè shì tàiyáng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The wind is very strong.
   B. Today there are clouds.
   C. This is the sun.
   D. The rain is heavy.

30. What does 不 (bù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Small
   B. Weather
   C. Not
   D. Very

31. What does 下面 (xiàmiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bathroom
   B. Fridge
   C. Table
   D. Below

32. What does 你 (nǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. I, me
   B. You
   C. And you? (a question word)
   D. Classmates

33. What does 家 (jiā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Daughter
   B. Home, family
   C. Son
   D. Older sister

34. Which Chinese word means "one"? (1 mark)
   A. 二 èr
   B. 一 yī
   C. 五 wǔ
   D. 四 sì

35. Which word is pronounced yǐnliào? (1 mark)
   A. 鸡肉
   B. 晚饭
   C. 饮料
   D. 饼

36. On which vowel is the tone mark in zuǐba? (1 mark)
   A. No vowel
   B. i
   C. a
   D. u

37. Which Chinese word means "small"? (1 mark)
   A. 小 xiǎo
   B. 不 bù
   C. 天气 tiānqì
   D. 雨 yǔ

38. What does 没有 (méiyǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sun
   B. It rains
   C. Snow
   D. There is not

39. Read the pinyin: mén zài zuǒbian. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The door is on the left.
   B. The sofa is beside the door.
   C. The television is on the table.
   D. There is a bed in the bedroom.

40. Which Chinese word means "window"? (1 mark)
   A. 桌子 zhuōzi
   B. 窗户 chuānghu
   C. 电视 diànshì
   D. 厨房 chúfáng

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write in Chinese and pinyin: "Today it rains." (2 marks)

42. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "That is my older brother." (2 marks)

43. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期天 and 早上好. (2 marks)

44. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see." (2 marks)

45. A picture shows a girl but the label says 儿子. Is the pair 对 or 错? Explain. (2 marks)

46. Write the numbers 1 to 5 in Chinese characters. (2 marks)

47. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my mother." (2 marks)

48. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: míngtiān shì xīngqīsì. (2 marks)

49. Give three tips for reading aloud clearly in Mandarin. (3 marks)

50. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 旁边 and 您好. (2 marks)

51. Compare how Mandarin and Kiswahili name family members. Give two similarities or differences. (4 marks)

52. Write in Chinese and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." (2 marks)

53. Rearrange and translate: 休息 / 星期六 / 在家 / 我. (3 marks)

54. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 清真寺 and 一. (2 marks)

55. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 香蕉 and 饼. (2 marks)

56. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 三 and 什么. (2 marks)

57. Explain two things that help you read a sentence at a good pace. (4 marks)

58. Write two strategies for speaking Chinese clearly. (3 marks)

59. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello!" (2 marks)

60. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The rain is heavy." (2 marks)

61. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 窗户 and 大家. (2 marks)

62. Write three things you could include in a class display and one thing to check. (3 marks)

63. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "We sing." (2 marks)

64. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "We cut the cake." (2 marks)

65. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 妹妹 and 米饭. (2 marks)

66. Write in Chinese with pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — 您好
   您好 is pronounced nín hǎo and means hello (polite).

2. D — ao
   h is the initial and ao is the final. The tone mark sits on the a.

3. D — And
   和 (hé) means and.

4. A — 这是我妈妈。
   谁 asks who, and the answer names a person.

5. B — 电视在哪儿?
   哪儿 is where and takes the place of the answer.

6. C — It keeps the home tidy and safe
   Things in the right place are easy to find and do not cause accidents.

7. C — Week
   星期 followed by a number makes the day names.

8. B — 星期五,去清真寺。
   星期五,去清真寺。 (xīngqīwǔ, qù qīngzhēnsì.) means "On Friday, go to the mosque.".

9. B — Tomorrow
   明天 (míngtiān) means tomorrow.

10. D — To play
   玩 (wán) means to play.

11. B — To wish
   祝 (zhù) means to wish.

12. C — Read slowly first, then join the words and speed up
   Slow reading first, then a natural speed.

13. B — Grapes
   葡萄 (pútao) means grapes.

14. C — 我用眼睛看。
   我用眼睛看。 (wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn.) means "I use my eyes to see.".

15. A — 摸 mō
   摸 (mō) means to touch.

16. A — It shows you understood the key points
   Retelling keeps the main ideas and shows understanding.

17. B — 很
   很 hěn means very.

18. C — 旁边
   旁边 pángbiān is beside.

19. B — 花园在房子右边。
   花园在房子右边。 (huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.) means "The garden is on the right of the house.".

20. B — 谢谢!
   谢谢! (xièxie!) means "Thank you!".

21. C — Right
   对 means right; 错 means wrong.

22. D — Toilet
   厕所 (cèsuǒ) means toilet.

23. B — Saturday
   星期六 (xīngqīliù) means Saturday.

24. D — 朋友送我礼物。
   朋友送我礼物。 (péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù.) means "My friend gives me a gift.".

25. A — To give (a gift)
   送 (sòng) means to give (a gift).

26. A — We
   我们 (wǒmen) means we.

27. A — 香蕉
   香蕉 is pronounced xiāngjiāo and means banana.

28. A — Looking for one particular word or fact
   Scanning finds a specific detail.

29. C — This is the sun.
   zhè shì tàiyáng. is 这是太阳。, which means "This is the sun.".

30. C — Not
   不 (bù) means not.

31. D — Below
   下面 (xiàmiàn) means below.

32. B — You
   你 (nǐ) means you.

33. B — Home, family
   家 (jiā) means home, family.

34. B — 一 yī
   一 (yī) means one.

35. C — 饮料
   饮料 is pronounced yǐnliào and means drinks.

36. B — i
   In ui the second vowel takes the mark.

37. A — 小 xiǎo
   小 (xiǎo) means small.

38. D — There is not
   没有 (méiyǒu) means there is not.

39. A — The door is on the left.
   mén zài zuǒbian. is 门在左边。, which means "The door is on the left.".

40. B — 窗户 chuānghu
   窗户 (chuānghu) means window.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 那是我哥哥。 nà shì wǒ gēge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期天: xīngqītiān, Sunday. 早上好: zǎoshang hǎo, good morning.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 错 (wrong). 儿子 means son, but the picture shows a girl.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying 错 and 1 mark for the reason.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 一, 二, 三, 四, 五.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for all five correct, 1 mark for three or four.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我妈妈。 zhè shì wǒ māma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tomorrow is Thursday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the whole line first; find the tones; read slowly and clearly; pause at punctuation; speak loudly enough for everyone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: 旁边: pángbiān, beside. 您好: nín hǎo, hello (polite).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: Similar: both repeat a syllable in words for close family, such as baba and bàba, mama and māma. Different: Mandarin has different words for older and younger brothers and sisters, but Kiswahili uses kaka and dada for both.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 4.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期六在家休息。 On Saturday I rest at home.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: 清真寺: qīngzhēnsì, mosque. 一: yī, one.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: 香蕉: xiāngjiāo, banana. 饼: bǐng, flat bread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: 三: sān, three. 什么: shénme, what.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: Read it slowly first; join the words together; speak at natural speed; keep the tones clear; record and listen back.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each explained point.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen first and copy the tone with your hand; say it slowly then faster; record yourself and compare.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each strategy, 1 mark for explaining how it helps.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你好! nǐ hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: 雨很大。 yǔ hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: 窗户: chuānghu, window. 大家: dàjiā, everybody.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example a labelled house plan, a birthday card and character models; check tone marks and stroke order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each item and 1 mark for a check.

63. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我们唱歌。 wǒmen chànggē.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

64. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我们切蛋糕。 wǒmen qiē dàngāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

65. (2 marks)
   Answer: 妹妹: mèimei, younger sister. 米饭: mǐfàn, cooked rice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

66. (2 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.
